evidence: The substrate temperature was 150 ° C. The precursors were zirconium tetra-tert-butoxide and H2O for the ZrO2 films and Ti-iso-propoxide and H2O for the TiO2 films, respectively. Typical Zr precursor/purge/H2O/purge times in one deposition cycle were 2 sec/ 80 sec/ 2 sec/ 240 sec, while the Ti precursor/purge/H2O/purge times in one deposition cycle were 2 sec/ 27 sec/ 2 sec/ 40 sec, consecutively.
